Text: Pick a power line to connect to
A power pole that can connect more and longer power lines. Also comes with a free decorative lamp.
When enabled, cables will always be visible, even when a building is not selected.
Maximum power line distance for regular buildings (meters). Buildings with a longer built-in range keep that longer range. Reload the map after changing.
Maximum power line distance for power generators (meters). Generators with a longer built-in range keep that longer range. Reload the map after changing.
